justification: core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/result has 37 production classes and 3,918 LOC, including 22 *Parser classes and 14 *ParsedResult classes. ResultParser.java centralizes a static chain of 20 parser implementations, and representative files such as VCardResultParser.java, WifiResultParser.java, VINResultParser.java, and CalendarParsedResult.java show the package covers many distinct responsibilities (contacts, calendar, Wi-Fi, VIN, email, SMS, URI, ISBN, product, geo), which is strong evidence of a God Component.
